title: Terminal Agents Suffice for Enterprise Automation
abstract: arXiv:2604.00073v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: There has been growing interest in building agents that can interact with digital platforms to execute meaningful enterprise tasks autonomously. Among the approaches explored are tool-augmented agents built on abstractions such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and web agents that operate through graphical interfaces. Yet, it remains unclear whether such complex agentic systems are necessary given their cost and operational overhead. We argue that a coding agent equipped only with a terminal and a filesystem can solve many enterprise tasks more effectively by interacting directly with platform APIs. We evaluate this hypothesis across diverse real-world systems and show that these low-level terminal agents match or outperform more complex agent architectures at a fraction of the cost. Our findings suggest that simple, flexible programmatic interfaces combined with strong foundation models should be the backbone of enterprise autom

translated_title: 终端智能体足以实现企业自动化
translated_abstract: 构建能够与数字平台交互、自主执行有意义企业任务的智能体，正受到越来越多的关注。目前探索的方法包括基于模型上下文协议等抽象构建的工具增强型智能体，以及通过图形界面操作的网页智能体。然而，考虑到其成本和运营开销，这类复杂的智能体系统是否必要仍不明确。我们认为，仅配备终端和文件系统的编码智能体可以通过直接与平台 API 交互，更有效地解决许多企业任务。我们在多样化的真实世界系统中对这一假设进行了评估，结果表明这些低级终端智能体只需极低的成本即可达到或超越更复杂的智能体架构。我们的发现表明，简单灵活的编程接口与强大的基础模型相结合，应当成为企业自动化的核心支柱。
tldr: 该论文提出仅配备终端和文件系统的编码智能体通过直接调用平台 API，就能以远低于复杂智能体架构（如 MCP 工具智能体和网页智能体）的成本，达到甚至超越它们在企业任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: A coding agent equipped with only a terminal and filesystem can match or outperform complex tool-augmented and web-based agent architectures on enterprise tasks at a fraction of the cost by directly interacting with platform APIs.
